boss-ultimate-yeti.selection_goal: Third deterministic BOSS candidate after Dragon_Evolved and MushroomKing failed production gates. Big Yeti must prove dominant phone-scale silhouette, intact materials, exact shared animation compatibility and real Android readability before qualification.

verdict.reason: Yeti is now sourced from an immutable GitHub-hosted Quaternius GLB mirror to eliminate Google Drive quota fragility. The mirror is pinned by repository commit, Git blob and byte size. A fresh validation must prove source SHA256, native actions, exact 232-frame QA, calibrated BOSS silhouette gates and visual integrity before qualification.
